column1: # What the glyph boxes tier of content_interp.rs can't say why it matched
# nothing for, by file: glyphs PDFium's text page makes no character of,
# and characters it makes that no glyph is, for no reason the tier names
# (a duplicate, a space its line passes over, an /ActualText). Most are
# glyphs whose text sheaf doesn't know, which the tier takes only at
# their origin, and characters of no width, or that PDFium's text page
# drops or makes otherwise (lone spaces, runs of spaces, right-to-left
# pieces). The tier fails where a file has more than its line says, and
# a file with no line has none; SHEAF_INTERP_WRITE_UNEXPLAINED=1 over
# every file writes the lines again, after these.
